system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The Actor is built upon a large language model (LLM) that is specifically prompted to generate the necessary text and actions conditioned on the state observations.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper describes few-shot prompts with task/trajectory variables; no repo evidence available.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we implement a Reflexion + ReAct [ 30] agent that can retrieve relevant context using a Wikipedia API and infer answers using step-by-step explicit thinking.
env_context_strategy.note: No repository context injection described; agent acts in environment.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we truncate the agent’s memory to the last 3 self-reflections (experiences).

observation_format.evidence_quote: receive an observation from the environmentot

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: These methods use LLMs to generate text and ‘actions‘ that can be used in API calls and executed in an environment.
tool_call_format.note: ReAct-style text actions parsed from output; code generation for programming tasks. No native function calling described.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: MBPP and HumanEval measure function body generation accuracy given natural language descriptions.
edit_primitive.note: Model emits the full function implementation each trial; no edit tool described.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: We release all code, demos, and datasets at https://github.com/noahshinn024/reflexion.
protocol_standardization.note: No protocol (MCP/A2A) mentioned anywhere in the paper; predates MCP.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: whileMe not pass ort< max trials do
loop_primitives.note: ReAct actor, self-generated unit tests for programming, repeated trials.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: form an improved plan of attack for the next attempt
planning_granularity.note: Planning only in free-text reflections; no stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: utilizing three distinct models: an Actor, denoted as Ma, which generates text and actions; anEvaluator model, represented byMe, that scores the outputs produced byMa; and a Self-Reflection model, denoted asMsr
multi_agent_topology.note: Fixed hand-off Actor -> Evaluator -> Self-Reflection each trial.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Actor, Evaluator, and Self-Reflection models work together through trials in a loop until the Evaluator deemsτt to be correct.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: To achieve fully autonomous behavior, we implement two self-evaluation techniques: natural language classification using an LLM and a hand-written heuristic.
human_in_loop.note: Loop is fully autonomous; no human gate described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the trajectory history serves as the short-term memory

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: outputs from the Self-Reflection model are stored in long-term memory
long_term_memory.note: In-process bounded buffer of past-trial reflections (Ω usually 1-3), not a DB on disk; closest value.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: we self-reflect. In the baseline runs, if self-reflection is suggested, we skip the self-reflection process, reset the environment, and start a new trial.
state_persistence.note: No resume of interrupted runs described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: simple binary environment feedback, pre-defined heuristics for common failure cases, and self-evaluation such as binary classification using LLMs (decision-making) or self-written unit tests (programming)

retry_policy.evidence_quote: whileMe not pass ort< max trials do
retry_policy.note: Retry until evaluator passes, with a max-trials cap.

rollback.evidence_quote: reset the environment, and start a new trial
rollback.note: Environment reset between trials rather than reverting agent edits; no undo/git mechanism described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: whileMe not pass ort< max trials do
termination_condition.note: Also a per-environment action cap: 'the number of actions taken in the current environment exceeds 30'.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: we bound mem by a maximum number of stored experiences, Ω (usually set to 1-3) to adhere to max context LLM limitations.
cost_controls.note: Context bounding for prompt length; no cost/token budget or caching mechanism reported.

timeouts.evidence_quote: if the agent executes the same action and receives the same response for more than 3 cycles, or if the number of actions taken in the current environment exceeds 30 (inefficient planning), we self-reflect
timeouts.note: Only step/cycle caps, which are not timeouts; no time limits reported.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: We highly advise others to use isolated execution environments when running autonomous code writing experiments as the generated code is not validated before execution.
execution_isolation.note: Implies generated code runs unisolated by default; isolation is advice, not shipped.

network_policy.evidence_quote: retrieve relevant context using a Wikipedia API
